TicketReviewOccupant.description: One slot's occupant on the wire: a human reviewer, or an agent reviewer under a named Execution Profile. A human slot carries no profile and is exempt from separation (DR-EP-15); a profile slot names its entry by reference, never inlined values. A human carries nothing but its tag, and every variant denies fields beyond its own: a smuggled `name` refuses the request rather than reading as a human and skipping the profile it would have named.

oneOf.description: An agent reviews under the profile `name` references.

name.description: The Execution Profile the slot's assignment names, by its catalogue name.

TicketReviewSlot.description: One parallel review slot on the wire (DR-EP-09): its occupant and its requirement.

requirement.description: Whether the stage cannot resolve without this slot finishing.

TicketReviewSlotRequirement.description: The closed slot requirement vocabulary on the wire (DR-EP-09): every required slot in a stage must finish before the stage resolves; an optional slot never blocks it.

oneOf.description: The stage cannot resolve without this slot finishing.
The slot never blocks the stage it sits in.

description: One ordered stage on the wire (DR-EP-09): parallel slots that resolve together.

slots.description: The parallel slots, in configured order.
